prompt: Two credible sources disagree about whether gateway Y enforces authorization centrally. Work out what we can actually claim.

assertions.name: disagreement_investigated
assertions.description: Response examines both conflicting sources rather than accepting one at face value

assertions.name: scope_version_compared
assertions.description: Response checks whether sources differ in scope, version, date, or configuration

assertions.name: conflict_preserved
assertions.description: Response uses 'Conflicting' label or explicitly preserves unresolved disagreement rather than choosing one source

assertions.name: no_arbitrary_selection
assertions.description: Response does not simply pick the more convenient or recent source without justification

assertions.name: provenance_recorded
assertions.description: Response tracks both sources with specific identifiers, dates, and locations
